trial_title: A Clinical Study to Evaluate the Pharmacokinetics of Testosterone Gel Using an Applicator
brief_summary: This is a Phase 2 clinical trial in adult hypogonadal males with baseline morning serum testosterone concentrations \<300 ng/dL. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the pharmacokinetics of FE 999303, delivered using an applicator in comparison to hand application
